display.title: Shabbos Mishpatim, Shekalim and Mevarchim Adar
display.summary_short: Three treats in one Shabbos: Parshas Mishpatim, the half-shekel of Parshas Shekalim, and blessing the happy month of Adar.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show for the Shabbos of Parshas Mishpatim in 5748. Uncle Yossi explains that Mishpatim, the first parsha after Mattan Torah, teaches that every mitzvah is done because Hashem Himself commanded it, as we say in each brachah: 'asher kideshanu b'mitzvosav v'tzivanu'. It is also Shabbos Shekalim, when we read about the half-shekel every adult gave for the Mishkan and later for the communal offerings in the Beis HaMikdash. Today we remember it by giving tzedakah to yeshivos and shuls, and by sharing what we have with others. Finally, it is Shabbos Mevarchim for Adar, the month when we increase in joy, so every child should come to shul to receive the blessing for the new month. Uncle Yossi ends with a prayer for Moshiach and the rebuilding of the Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: We do every mitzvah because Hashem commanded it, and we share our blessings with others through tzedakah.
